time.description: The range of time represented by the values used to calculate the trend.

values.description: The values used to calculate the trend.

mean.description:
The aggregated value. By default this is the arithmetic mean (simple average), but may also be another statistic
as specified by {@link PerfMetricTrendsSpec#aggregateBy}.

change.description: The overall change fraction of a line using linear regression.

changesDetected.description: Interesting inflection points detected in the values (0-based indexes and corresponding dates).

title:
This type represents an analysis of changes over time.

@see PerfMetric#trend
name: PerfMetricTrend
